titulo: Search on for at least 33 Britons missing after flash floods in Nepal and Tibet
cuerpo: Rescue teams trying to locate nearly 1,400 missing people, mostly tourists, after floods killed at least 353 Nepal-Tibet flash flood – latest updates Rescue teams in Nepal are searching for at least 33 British nationals who are among those missing after flash floods ravaged its border with Tibet, killing at least 353 people. Nearly 1,400 people are missing, most of them tourists, authorities have said, after a glacier collapse triggered floods that roared down valleys and razed entire villages . Continue reading...
